sections.title: CORN BELT/UPR MS VLY
sections.text: ELEVATED CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING EARLY FRIDAY MORNING OVER A LARGE PART OF THE CORN BELT AND UPR MS VLY. THESE STORMS WILL BE SUPPORTED BY CONSIDERABLE MOISTURE TRANSPORT ALONG THE AXIS OF A 40-50 KT SSWLY LLJ. STRONGER STORMS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY HAIL OR GUSTY WINDS...BUT THE PRIMARY SVR RISKS WILL EVOLVE LATER IN THE DAY. UPR LOW OVER THE NRN GRT BASIN IS FCST TO MOVE VERY SLOWLY EWD DURING THE FCST PD. DOWNSTREAM UPR RIDGE WILL BUILD NWD WITH A STOUT ELEVATED MIXED LAYER SPREADING DOWNSTREAM ACROSS MOST OF THE PLNS/CORN BELT. THUS...WHILE SUBSTANTIAL LLVL MOISTENING IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR ALONG/S OF THE RETREATING WRMFNT INTO THE REGION...CONSIDERABLE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS ALSO EXPECTED. THIS COUPLED WITH WEAK LARGE SCALE FORCING THROUGH MOST OF PEAK HEATING COULD LIMIT/DELAY SFC-BASED INITIATION UNTIL NEAR EVENING. PERSISTENT WSWLY LLVL FEED OF HOT/UNSTABLE PARCELS...APPROACH OF A WEAK MID-LVL WAVE /CURRENTLY OVER WRN CO/ AND CONVERGENCE INVOF THE WRMFNT COULD WEAKEN THE CAP SUFFICIENTLY FOR SFC-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PARTS OF CNTRL/SRN MN AND IA DURING THE EARLY EVENING. STRONG INSTABILITY AND DEEP LAYER IN EXCESS OF 45 KTS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SU

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLNS
sections.text: A SEPARATE REGION OF SVR POTENTIAL WILL EVOLVE ACROSS THE NRN/CNTRL PLNS FRIDAY AFTN/EVE. A LEAD MID-LVL WAVE EJECTING NWD INTO THE NRN HIGH PLNS EARLY FRIDAY WILL SUPPORT CONSIDERABLE CONVECTION ACROSS CNTRL/ERN MT AND PARTS OF ND/SD EARLY IN THE PD. LOW PROBABILITIES OF HAIL/GUSTY WINDS MAY ACCOMPANY SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY. MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR THREATS SHOULD DEVELOP DURING THE AFTN/EVE ACROSS ERN MT AND EVENTUALLY FARTHER E IN THE CNTRL DKTS. LLVL MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO WRAP WNW ALONG THE RETREATING WRMFNT AND WWD ALONG NRN PERIPHERY OF A LEE LOW INTO ERN MT WITH MID-50S TO MID-60S F SFC DEW POINTS LIKELY. TSTMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP EARLY IN THE AFTN ALONG THE MOUNTAINS OF MT/WY AS LARGE SCALE HEIGHT FALLS EDGE EWD ALONG THE DIVIDE. MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR WILL CONTRIBUTE TO HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL/DMGG WIND GUSTS. AS STORMS DEVELOP ENE ATOP INCREASING MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW WILL PROBABLY LEAD TO STRONGER STORMS DURING THE LATE AFTN OVER ERN MT WITH DEVELOPMENT INTO LEWPS/BOWS. MEANWHILE...DOWNSTREAM...OTHER STORMS WILL DEVELOP ALONG NRN EDGE OF A LLVL DRY SLOT/TRIPLE POINT OVER WRN SD NWD ALONG AN INVERTED-TROUGH INTO

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PATTERN WILL REMAIN FAIRLY AMPLIFIED THIS PERIOD AS SEASONABLY STRONG GRT BASIN UPR LOW EDGES SLOWLY E...AND HEIGHTS REBOUND ACROSS THE TN VLY IN WAKE OF SYSTEM DEPARTING NEW ENGLAND. IN STREAM OF FLOW ON IMMEDIATE FRINGE OF SRN STATES RIDGE...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW IN ERN CO THAT SHOULD REACH ERN NEB THIS EVE ...AND WI/LK MI BY 12Z SAT. AT LWR LEVELS...WARM FRONT NOW EXTENDING E/SE FROM LEE LOW IN WRN SD SHOULD REDEVELOP NE INTO SE SD/SW MN AND WRN IA BY EVE...AND INTO WI/IL EARLY SAT. BOUNDARY LIKELY WILL REMAIN FAIRLY DIFFUSE...IN ADDITION TO BEING DISRUPTED/SEGMENTED BY ONGOING... LOOSELY-ASSOCIATED CLUSTERS OF CONVECTION.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY INTO IA/NRN IL
sections.text: NUMEROUS AREAS OF STORMS/LOOSELY-ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS LIKELY WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY OVER ERN PARTS OF THE NRN PLNS SE INTO MUCH OF IA...MN...WI AND NRN IL. THIS ELEVATED ACTIVITY WILL BE FED BY PERSISTENT WAA ALONG AND N/E OF AFOREMENTIONED WARM FRONT. SATELLITE-DERIVED PW DATA SUGGEST THAT MOISTURE AVAILABILITY WILL INCREASE WITH TIME...ESPECIALLY ALONG AXIS OF SSWLY LLJ EXTENDING FROM ERN KS/NEB INTO IA AND SRN MN. AS RESULT...SOME STORMS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY HAIL OR GUSTY WINDS. THE PRIMARY SVR THREAT ACROSS THE REGION SHOULD...HOWEVER...EVOLVE LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT AS SFC HEATING...CONTINUED MOISTURE INFLOW /PW AROUND 2 INCHES/...AND APPROACH OF CO DISTURBANCE FURTHER DESTABILIZE AREA NEAR FRONT. PRESENCE OF EML WILL RESULT IN SUBSTANTIAL CIN. IN ADDITION...DPVA /ASIDE FROM THAT PROVIDED BY CO IMPULSE/...WILL BE FAIRLY WEAK GIVEN FACT THAT LARGE SCALE UPR RDG WILL BE CENTERED OVER THE NRN PLNS. THUS...SFC OR NEAR SFC-BASED STORM INITIATION COULD BE DELAYED UNTIL EARLY EVE. ONCE CAP IS BREACHED...HOWEVER...STORMS SHOULD FORM RAPIDLY OVER CNTRL/SRN MN SWD INTO WRN/CNTRL IA. STRONG INSTABILITY...40+ KT DEEP WNWLY SHEAR...AND WEAK SFC FORCING SHOULD FAVOR DISCRET

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLNS
sections.text: A SEPARATE AREA OF SVR STORMS LIKELY WILL DEVELOP OVER FROM ERN MT/NRN WY INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS AND PERHAPS NW NEB THIS AFTN INTO TONIGHT. THIS ACTIVITY INITIALLY WILL BE TIED TO LEAD UPR IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH GRT BASIN LOW /NOW ARCING FROM CNTRL MT SE INTO CNTRL WY/. AS SFC HEATING DESTABILIZES LOW LVL MOIST AXIS THAT WILL PERSIST ALONG AND N OF SFC TROUGH/OCCLUSION...EXPECT SOME INTENSIFICATION OF EXISTING STORMS AND ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT BY MIDDAY. MARGINALLY SVR HAIL/WIND MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY. MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR STORMS SHOULD FORM THIS AFTN/EVE OVER ERN MT AND NRN WY AS WRN SD LEE LOW STRENGTHENS...ALLOWING MOIST...LOW LVL SELY FLOW TO INCREASE OVER REGION. DEWPOINTS IN THE UPR 50S TO MID 60S F BENEATH 500 MB TEMPERATURES AROUND MINUS 10C WILL YIELD SBCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. COUPLED WITH 35-40 KT SWLY MID LVL FLOW...SETUP SHOULD ALLOW TSTMS/HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS FORMING OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF NRN WY/SRN MT TO STRENGTHEN AS THEY DEVELOP NE INTO INCREASING MOISTURE OVER ERN MT. LEWPS/BOWS WILL BE LIKELY...AND SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST INTO EARLY SAT EWD INTO WRN ND. MEANWHILE...OTHER STORMS LIKELY WILL FORM FARTHER E...JUST N AND E OF LEE LOW IN WRN SD/SRN ND...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: STRONG UPPER TROUGH WILL PERSIST IN THE WEST...AS UPPER RIDGE BUILDS EWD ACROSS THE SERN STATES. BETWEEN THESE TWO SYSTEMS...MODERATELY STRONG MID/HIGH LEVEL FLOW WILL EXTEND FROM THE SRN GREAT BASIN NEWD THROUGH THE NRN/CENTRAL PLAINS...AND THEN EWD INTO THE NERN STATES. AT THE SURFACE...A WARM FRONT...CURRENTLY EXTENDING SEWD INTO THE MID MS VALLEY...IS FORECAST TO STRETCH FROM SRN SD EWD INTO NERN IA/NRN IL BY EVENING.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS EWD INTO WI/IL
sections.text: SEVERE EVOLUTION TODAY IS COMPLICATED GIVEN WIDESPREAD CLOUDS...ALONG WITH A LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTER MOVING EWD INTO NWRN IL/NERN MO...AND ANOTHER SMALLER CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS IN NERN ND. WV IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT AN UPPER IMPULSE MOVING THROUGH NWRN SD MAY AID STRONG/SEVERE ELEVATED CONVECTION TO SPREAD/DEVELOP EWD INTO MN THIS AFTERNOON...WITH HAIL THE MAIN CONCERN GIVEN THE CLOUDS AND STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. ANOTHER IMPULSE IS ALSO EVIDENT LIFTING NEWD ACROSS ERN CO AND MAY AID IN CONVECTION LATER TODAY. HOWEVER...STRONG WARMING ALOFT...700 MB TEMPERATURES FROM 12 TO 15C...SHOULD LIMIT SURFACE BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT...AT LEAST UNTIL STRONGER FORCING ARRIVES LATE IN THE DAY. MOST LIKELY LOCATION FOR INITIATION SHOULD BE NEAR THE WARM FRONT IN NERN NEB/SERN SD/WRN IA...WHERE CONVERGENCE WILL BE STRENGTHENING AND SUNSHINE SHOULD WARM TEMPERATURES TO AROUND 90F. ONCE CAP IS BREACHED AND STORMS DEVELOP...THE COMBINATION OF STRONG INSTABILITY AND 40+ KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR SHOULD FAVOR DISCRETE SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND EVEN A TORNADO OR TWO. THE LOW LEVEL JET SHOULD AID IN CONSOLIDATING THESE STORMS INTO AN EWD MOVING MCS OVERNIGHT...WITH

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED CONVECTION WAS OCCURRING ACROSS MT THIS MORNING WITHIN STRONGLY DIFFLUENT FLOW ALOFT...AHEAD OF UPPER LOW SITUATED OVER ID. MORE SUBSTANTIAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATER TODAY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN MT AND NRN WY...DUE TO HEATING OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW AND WEAK FORCING ALOFT. DEWPOINTS AROUND 60F BENEATH 500 MB TEMPERATURES OF -10C TO -12C WILL YIELD MLCAPES RANGING FROM 1000-2000 J/KG. COUPLED WITH 35-40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR...SETUP SHOULD ALLOW SUPERCELLS TO FORM OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF NRN WY/SRN MT...AND THEN INTENSIFY AS THEY SHIFT NEWD INTO THE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. LEWPS/BOWS WILL BE LIKELY...AS WELL AS A FEW DISCRETE CELLS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. ..IMY/SCHNEIDER.. 08/07/2009

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: PORTION OF SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN EXTENDED SWD ACROSS CENTRAL WY TO ACCOUNT FOR THE WY PORTION OF A FRONT WHICH EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL WY ENEWD INTO W/NW SD AND THEN NWD ALONG THE MT/ND BORDER TO SERN SASKATCHEWAN. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED AIR MASS NWD FROM CENTRAL WY INTO SERN/ERN MT HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH WEAKENED SURFACE BASED INHIBITION. SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED BUILDING CU WITH A FEW CBS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN EXTENDING FROM WRN WY TO SOUTH CENTRAL MT. AN INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT/ COVERAGE IS EXPECTED INTO THE EVENING AS FORCING FOR ASCENT SPREADS ENEWD ATTENDANT TO SEVERAL IMPULSES/SHORTWAVE TROUGHS TRACKING NEWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS FORECAST PERIOD. STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /UP TO 50 KT/ ALREADY IN PLACE ACROSS THIS REGION COMBINED WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY ARE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS AS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS/SPREADS OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO THE GREATER INSTABILITY.

sections.title: MID MO VALLEY TO SRN MN/IA
sections.text: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED A WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM ERN SD SEWD THROUGH NWRN-SERN IA INTO IL. A VERY MOIST AIR MASS /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S/ ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR ALONG THE MID AND LOWER MO RIVER VALLEY COMBINED WITH STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS CONTRIBUTING TO VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG/. AIR MASS ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY REMAINS CAPPED GIVEN STABLE CHARACTER OF CLOUDS IN THE FORM OF BILLOWS FROM CENTRAL/WRN IA TO SERN SD...WITH OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWING SURFACE BASED INHIBITION IN THIS SAME AREA. GIVEN THIS CAP...IT APPEARS THAT FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH WRN KS/SWRN NEB...WILL BE NEEDED TO WEAKEN THE CAP AS THIS TROUGH PROGRESSES NEWD. AT THIS TIME...TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR IN THE VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT...WITH 18Z RUC SUGGESTING CONVECTIVE INITIATION BETWEEN 21-00Z ACROSS ERN NEB/WRN IA. INCREASING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND THE AVAILABLE INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS. THIS COMBINED WITH STRENGTHENING SSWLY LLJ INTO ERN NEB/WRN IA THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING WILL RESULT IN STRONG LOW LEVEL SHEAR WITH AN ATTENDANT TORNADO THREAT INTO THE EVENING. THIS OUTLOOK MAINTAINS
